summary: KB Components AB (publ) designs, develops, manufactures, and sells polymer components for light vehicles, heavy vehicles, medical technology, general industry, furniture, industrial windows, and packaging and lighting in Sweden and internationally. It offers polymer components for light and heavy vehicle interior, exterior, and powertrain applications; polymers and composites for protective equipment, water treatment and management, and fine mechanics and industrial products; and industrial windows, such as industrial garage parts, inner and outer frames; and spare parts such as screws, ISO handle, grips, and rubbers; and injection-moulded components for furniture segments. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Örkelljunga, Sweden.
